findings.explanation: HOL4 allows the two lists to have different element types. For example, it can compare `[0]` with `[T]` using a comparator of type `num → bool → ordering` that always returns `LESS`. Lean requires both lists to have element type `α`, so this application is ill-typed.
findings.repair:
def collate {α : Type u} {β : Type v} (f : α → β → Ordering) : List α → List β → Ordering
  | [], [] => EQUAL
  | [], _ :: _ => LESS
  | _ :: _, [] => GREATER
  | h1 :: t1, h2 :: t2 => if f h1 h2 = EQUAL then collate f t1 t2 else f h1 h2
